title: Logos 16 opening: eternity of the Son; undivided from Father’s substance
english: Sixteenth discourse. On the Son’s eternity, and that he came forth undividedly from the Father’s substance.
No cut in the simple nature; generation without partition.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
